checklist.detail: At the throat, combined hoop + thermal-restraint stress (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall) is ~605 MPa (hoop ~13 MPa from a ~1.9 MPa net jacket-vs-gas differential + thermal-restraint ~592 MPa) against a ~67 MPa allowable (Stainless Steel (304/316), SF 1.5), with the wall at its minimum-stress thickness ~0.20 mm. This uses a real handbook stress formula (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall), not a proxy - worth a closer structural look. The thermal-restraint term dominates and grows with wall thickness (dT = q*t/k), so the wall is already at its ~0.2 mm minimum - consider a higher-conductivity liner (a copper alloy such as GRCop-84/NARloy-Z) or less throat heat flux (film cooling, lower Pc).

warnings: Nozzle/bell cooling method 'regenerative' is not physically possible on Ablative Phenolic-Silica (it can only be built for: ablative). BLOCKED - using its own 'ablative' cooling instead.

At the throat, combined hoop + thermal-restraint stress (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall) is ~605 MPa (hoop ~13 MPa from a ~1.9 MPa net jacket-vs-gas differential + thermal-restraint ~592 MPa) against a ~67 MPa allowable (Stainless Steel (304/316), SF 1.5), with the wall at its minimum-stress thickness ~0.20 mm. This uses a real handbook stress formula (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall), not a proxy - worth a closer structural look. The thermal-restraint term dominates and grows with wall thickness (dT = q*t/k), so the wall is already at its ~0.2 mm minimum - consider a higher-conductivity liner (a copper alloy such as GRCop-84/NARloy-Z) or less throat heat flux (film cooling, lower Pc).
Nozzle is separated at sea level even at 100% throttle (Pe/Pa=0.049) - this is a vacuum/high-altitude nozzle, not suited to a sea-level-igniting stage.
